FIELD NOTE / 01

Heat first raises the temperature.

At the starting point, 100 g of liquid water is at 20°C. Adding 33.44 kJ raises it to 100°C in this idealised, no-heat-loss model.

ENERGY ACCOUNTING0.00 / 33.44 kJ

The first 33.44 kJ goes into raising the temperature. At 100°C, later energy goes into phase change.
